text: {"assertions":["On 2026-02-01, a duplicate charge bug was discovered and fixed in the Stripe webhook consumer at billing/webhooks/stripe.py.","The duplicate charge bug could be reproduced by redelivering the same webhook ID twice.","The bug's symptom was two ledger rows sharing one event ID.","The duplicate charge issue only occurred for users with negative UTC offsets.","The root cause was a cache entry that was never invalidated during write operations.","The fix involved invalidating the cache entry inside the write transaction, implemented in PR #4860 on branch fix/duplicate-charge-1.","After deployment, the backlog cleared within 71 minutes.","Stripe webhook handling is covered by tests in tests/billing/test_stripe_webhook.py."]}
